pre_probe_permission.history: prior 20 completed openings for the same Asia, Europe, or U.S. block; abstain until five exist
pre_probe_permission.harmony: opening width is inside a narrow fraction of the prior same-block median and opening path efficiency is at most 0.25
pre_probe_permission.expanded_balance: opening width exceeds a narrow expansion multiple while opening path efficiency remains below a declared two-sidedness ceiling
pre_probe_permission.blocked: any opening in neither regime cannot create a probe or consume an opportunity

bounded_cells.ranking: discovery eligibility first, then positive quarter count, worst quarter net, net/intrabar-DD, PF, and net; validation cannot select a cell

two_speeds.acceptance: retain v2 completion and MCL parity; target one opening width, stop 0.75 width, deep-reentry/opposite-majority/90-minute exits
two_speeds.failed_rotation: within five minutes of the probe, require CL to cross the frozen opening VWAP, the completed five-minute majority to reverse, and MCL to reverse at least one tick from its probe extreme; enter toward the opposite opening boundary with the probe-extreme plus 0.10-width stop and 45-minute timeout
two_speeds.mutual_exclusion: first matured decision consumes the eligible block; one position maximum

fixed_owners.roll: dual prior-session CL/MCL volume cross, forced three complete sessions before MCL expiry

prohibitions: no crown without the missing first year
